prompt: Use the attached locked V9 Companion sheet as the only visual reference. Generate exactly one single horizontal strip of four equally spaced, isolated V9-matched Daily attention face sources, in this exact left-to-right order: looking left, looking right, looking up, looking down. This is only the four calm Daily attention directions. Pure white background; black and white only; no text, labels, panel, border, device frame or separator lines. All four have the same one persistent V9 character identity and same calm petite mouth, cheek dots, brows and detached top diamond charm. HARD EYE IDENTITY INVARIANT: each source has exactly two matched upright solid filled black vertical oval eye bodies on one horizontal baseline at locked-V9 compact scale. Each eye has one very small compact primary white reflection plus one much smaller static white diamond sparkle. Both white marks stay enclosed in black with a thick continuous rim and never touch an eye edge; no white cap, lower-half cutout, sclera, ring, outline, pupil, lash, changed eye shape, enlarged eye or extra highlight. Direction must be unmistakably encoded by only the compact primary reflection: source 1 center at 30 percent of eye width; source 2 center at 70 percent; source 3 center at 25 percent of eye height; source 4 center at 70 percent of eye height. For source 4 the lower reflection is tiny, fully surrounded by black, and leaves a thick black lower rim. The small diamond sparkle is identical in all four sources. Do not add question, exclamation, heart, spark, recording dot, sound arcs, ellipsis, sleep mark, moon, crescent or Z. No cat outline, ears, whiskers, human styling, smirk, flirtation, romance, sadness, aggression, grey, gradient, shading, texture, labels, charging face or error face. This is static art source for later source-component choreography, never animation playback or a runtime asset.
negative_constraints: no hollow, ring, contour, exposed-white, white-cap or lower-half-white open eyes
no reflection touching an eye edge, no large lower reflection, no weak black rim around either reflection
no changed eye size, rotation, side-eye, drooping, eyelash or eye-hugging arc
no V1, V2, V3, V4, V5, V6, V7 or V8 pixels, components or visual reference
no whole-face animation claim, CEMP/PBM flipbook or runtime activation
no question, exclamation, heart, spark, record dot, sound arcs, ellipsis, moon, crescent, Z, charging or error face
post_generation_gate: Run the V9 open-eye identity and Daily left/right/up/down reflection-readability gates on the 1x4 strip. A pass permits only creation of the complementary expanded emotion-source request; no component export, runtime activation, full-face playback or owner art review occurs until the complete sixteen-state source bundle is generated and machine-cleared.
